scheme_name: Dr. D.S. Kothari Research Grant For Newly Recruited Faculty Members
other_conditions: Faculty must be regularly appointed and working in universities, deemed‑to‑be universities, centrally or state funded institutions, or institutions of national importance that have valid NAAC accreditation
Applicant must be a newly appointed Assistant Professor on a permanent post
Applicant must hold a Ph.D. degree and have at least five research papers published in internationally reputed journals
Application must be submitted within two years of joining the post
benefits_summary: Provides a two‑year research grant of ₹10,00,000 to newly recruited Assistant Professors (132 slots), covering equipment, consumables, travel and related research expenses.
